facts.fact: La Marina BJ reports the DGI tax file (IFU) is attached to the NPI: 439,333 of 1,077,679 IFU were linked on 25 October 2023, and the IDA PReM-Benin programme funds real-time IFU-NPI matching.
The Ministry of Economy and Finance stated that on 25 October 2023, 439,333 of 1,077,679 IFU were attached to an NPI, a 40.76% rate.
